import subprocess

# Test the anchorlink case
result = subprocess.run(['python', '-c', '''
import markdown
from markdown.extensions.toc import TocExtension
md = markdown.Markdown(extensions=[TocExtension(anchorlink=True)])
text = "# Header 1" + chr(10) + chr(10) + "## Header *2*"
result = md.convert(text)
print(result)
'''], capture_output=True, text=True)
print(result.stdout)
if result.returncode != 0:
    print("STDERR:", result.stderr)
